claims.evidence: Witness only reports visible features (mountain bike with front suspension, disc rotor, rack area); no durability test or structural inspection shown.
Witness notes drivetrain looks intact from the angle, but no close-ups of brake pad/rotor wear, tyre condition, frame joints, or wheel/bearing play.
No brand/model markings or proof of purchase date shown in the witness report.
Witness confirms a front disc rotor is visible, but does not show brake pad condition or a gear-shift test.
No close-up coverage of frame joints, chain/cassette, or other rust-prone areas; originality cannot be confirmed without readable markings/parts close-ups.

risks.risk: Brake condition beyond the visible rotor (pad wear, rotor thickness, brake lever feel) could be poor even if a disc rotor is present.
risks.proof: One clear close-up of both brake pads and the rotor surface (front and rear if present), plus a short clip braking from a slow roll showing strong stopping and no squeal/drag.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown brake wear (assume may need pad/rotor service).

risks.risk: Tyre health (tread depth, sidewall cracks, bulges) and whether tyres are safe for Lagos roads.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (sidewall + tread) and a clip showing tyres inflated and not wobbling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may be worn/aged (assume replacement may be needed).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and bearing condition (front/rear play, wobble) not shown by the single outdoor angle.
risks.proof: Clip of the bike lifted and spun (front wheel and rear wheel) showing smooth rotation; also a photo of the wheel straightness from the front and rear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bearings/alignment may need adjustment or replacement.

risks.risk: Frame hidden damage (dents/cracks/rust at joints) not visible from the reported angle.
risks.proof: Walk-around close-ups of the frame at joints (bottom bracket area, head tube, seat stays, chain stays) under good light, plus a straight-edge/inspection clip if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as frame condition unknown (assume possible minor damage).

risks.risk: Drivetrain wear (chain stretch, cassette/sprocket wear, shifting performance) not verified.
risks.proof: Clip of shifting through all gears while pedaling (front and rear), plus close-up of chain and cassette/sprockets.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain may need cleaning/lubrication and possible chain/cassette service.

risks.risk: Unclear specification (single-speed vs multi-speed, exact gear count, brand/model) affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of the shifter/derailleur area showing gear setup and any readable brand/model markings on frame/fork.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely spec for a generic mountain bike with disc front.

proof_requests: Clear photos of any readable brand/model markings on the frame and fork (or a close-up of the head tube/sticker area).
A short video of braking from a slow roll (front and rear if rear brake exists) showing stopping power and no grinding/squeal.
Close-up photos of brake pads and rotor surfaces (front and rear).
Close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls (both tyres).
Video of both wheels spinning while lifted to check bearing smoothness and wobble.
Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-ups of chain and cassette/sprockets.
Photos of frame joints (head tube, bottom bracket, seat stays, chain stays) to check for cracks/rust.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a mountain bike with front suspension, disc rotor, and visible drivetrain, so it can be priced at a worst-case used condition. However, key condition details (brakes, tyres, bearings, frame integrity, shifting) are not shown, so it should be priced conservatively until proof is provided.
